snippet.title: Pass the Fear | Official Demo Launch Trailer 🌪️ #roguelite #bullethell #indiegame
snippet.description:
🏃 A ragtag crew on the run: the Iron Bucket Knight, the Explosive Cutie, the One-Eyed Codger, the Money Whiz, and a mysterious nun they picked up along the way...

Every one of them is afraid to die, but they have no choice but to grab their guns and fight! 🔫

⏳ Your mission is to escape the island within 12 hours. But when you reach the coast, your path is blocked by the seemingly impenetrable Storm Wall.

As more and more monsters emerge, a dark conspiracy begins to unfold... 🌪️

🎮 The demo for Pass the Fear, a brand-new Roguelite bullet-hell shooter, is now available!

Demon Hunters, head to Steam and give it a try!

🕛 Demo available from:
December 14, 2025 at 12:00 (UTC+8)

🔥 Play the Demo NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561220
